input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligations into § 3.5 (Effect of Termination).
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause to § 3.5 so that, on expiry or termination, IBM provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and then deletes and certifies deletion. Our playbook requires a workable exit path; if six months is an issue we can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall: (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return to Customer all Content and other Customer data in IBM's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
